description: The status a tool Step records when an attempt of CallTool or CallSingleAttemptTool ends with ToolExecutionError, from the record's effect, whether a tool source built the call (toolSourceReference is not null), and the attempt number. A first attempt, a read, and a tool source's call record failed. A later attempt of any other call records outcome_unknown, because an earlier attempt reached a Worker and ended without a final record, so its tool may have taken effect: a refusal on the retry, such as an unknown tool after a rename or arguments that a changed schema rejects, says nothing about that attempt. A tool source classifies its own errors; see argumentRefusalCases in connector_tools.json. Hand-written; see README.md.

cases.name: a read on its first attempt
an idempotent write on its first attempt
an idempotent write on its second attempt
an idempotent write on its last attempt
